hooks.command:
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [ -f "$FILE" ]; then VIOLATIONS=""; MANTINE=$(grep -n "from ['''"@mantine/" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "@peppermint" | head -3); EFFECT=$(grep -n "useEffect" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "fetch|axios|\.get\(|\.post\(|api " | head -3); INLINE_AXIOS=$(grep -n "axios\.(get\|post\|put\|patch\|delete)\|new axios" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -3); if [ -n "$MANTINE" ]; then VIOLATIONS="$VIOLATIONS
[VIOLATION] Direct @mantine/ import — use @peppermint/ui instead:
$MANTINE"; fi; if [ -n "$EFFECT" ]; then VIOLATIONS="$VIOLATIONS
[VIOLATION] Possible useEffect data fetch — use useQuery instead:
$EFFECT"; fi; if [ -n "$INLINE_AXIOS" ]; then VIOLATIONS="$VIOLATIONS
[VIOLATION] Inline Axios call in event handler — use useMutation instead:
$INLINE_AXIOS"; fi; if [ -n "$VIOLATIONS" ]; then echo -e "[pre-edit] Anti-pattern detected in $FILE:$VIOLATIONS
Fix before proceeding."; fi; fi'

bash -c 'echo "[new-file] File created. Quick checklist:"; echo "  - If this is a component: does a .types.ts file exist?"; echo "  - Is the barrel export (index.ts) updated?"; echo "  - If in packages/: is the group barrel updated?"; echo "  - If this is a new module or sub-module: run /update-ai-map"'

bash -c 'CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -E "\.(tsx|ts)$"); if [ -n "$CHANGED" ]; then echo "[post-response] Modified TS/TSX files:"; echo "$CHANGED" | head -8; echo ""; echo "Before closing: /verify (typecheck+lint) · /simplify if >10 lines changed · /update-ai-map if structure changed"; fi'
